description: Explain the pitch factor on a roof card and give one roof's sloping area. DISTILL-CANARY-78ce73f4

files.README.md:
# Ellerbeck Roofing Supplies - estimating

Shared folder for the trade counter.

- roofs/  cards for each roof and bay
- slates/  stock notes from the yard

turns.prompt: A roofer new to Ellerbeck Roofing Supplies asked what the pitch factor on a roof card is for; a sloping roof covers more than the plan area beneath it, in the proportion of the sloping length to the run. Roof R-31 covers 128 square metres of plan at a pitch of 9 units of rise for every 12 units of run. Give the area of the sloping roof, as a single number in square metres with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
